title: Filming: Venus And Mars promo by Wings | 1975
content:
A promo clip for Wings’ fourth album Venus And Mars was filmed on 5 May 1975.

The shoot took place at a private house in London’s Holland Park, and the director was Karel Reisz.

The footage included shots of Wings messing around and playing pool. The 60-second clip, which was first shown on ITV on 25 June, was edited to include audio of ‘Venus And Mars’, ‘You Gave Me The Answer’, ‘Listen To What The Man Said’, ‘Treat Her Gently – Lonely Old People’, ‘Medicine Jar’, and ‘Venus And Mars (Reprise)’.
